title: Are your pet products genuine?
content: Yes. We stock trusted brands and source from authorised distributors so you receive authentic pet food, litter, and accessories.

title: How long does delivery take?
content: Colombo and suburbs: 1–2 business days. Other areas: 2–4 business days. Orders placed before 2:00 PM on a business day are processed the same day.

title: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
content: Yes. Cash on Delivery is available island-wide. Please keep the exact amount ready for the delivery rider.

title: Can I return or exchange an item?
content: Unopened items in original packaging may be returned within 7 days. Damaged or incorrect orders should be reported within 48 hours. See our Return Policy for full details.

title: What if an item is out of stock?
content: Contact us and we will let you know when the item is back in stock or suggest a suitable alternative for your pet.

title: How are delivery charges calculated?
content: Delivery charges are calculated at checkout based on order weight and destination. Free delivery is available on qualifying orders — the threshold is shown in your cart.

title: Installments with credit cards?
content: We support 3–24 month installment plans for selected banks. Check at checkout or contact our team for assistance.

title: Is KOKO payment available?
content: Yes. KOKO 3-month installment plans are supported for eligible orders during checkout.

title: How should I store pet food after delivery?
content: Keep dry food in a cool, dry place in a sealed container. Check expiry dates on arrival and before feeding your pet.

title: Need more help?
content: Call or message us — our team is happy to help with product recommendations, orders, and delivery questions.
